note: Set A binds the threaded-rod system well (2-1/4" dia., A36, varying lengths to accommodate up to 12" elevation difference) and correctly pairs plate diameters with thicknesses (11" and 28" dia. x 1/2"), plus T.O. steel, neoprene pad and grade/first-floor elevations; Set B omits the rod diameter and the 12" accommodation entirely. Set B's clear defects are worse: it calls L3X3X1/4 the column cap plate specification (that is a separate angle) and reads "3X 1/4"" as a diagonal-brace plate of 1/4" thickness in quantity 3, and it pads the set with four unbound "component/detail typ" dimension claims. Set A's main errors are two claims on PL3-1/2X3-1/2X1 (thickness given as 1/2" and "length" given as 1", when 1 is the thickness), plus a couple of vague or duplicated claims. Overall A is more faithful and better bound, though both sets miss facts the other captures (B's keeper plate, pin connection plate, heavy hex nut, A325 bolt, W8X10).
